ticket.subject: API down for all our workspaces
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Writing on behalf of Fennimore Freight. All of our API requests have failed with HTTP 500 since 10:20 UTC, for every workspace and every API key we have.

Your status page still shows everything as operational.

We have a hard deadline tomorrow morning, so please treat this as urgent. Please confirm you are aware and give us an estimate.

Thanks,
Bruno

label_notes: clean outage (outage-all-500): the API is down across all workspaces, which is outage material and P1; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
